saved mask comes from C14, which reads thr_s, tgt and sea from /work/inter.npz written in C7. In C7 the per-day-of-year hazen thresholds are built from ±5-day pools over 1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05 and smoothed with a cumulative-sum moving mean, so every unsmoothed day (and therefore every baseline-window date, including 1991-12-27..31 and 2003-01-01..05) is an arithmetic input to thr_s. C14 then compares all 92 target days 2021-06-01 to 2021-08-31 for every sea cell against thr_s and builds the per-cell MHW runs written to output/mhw_mask.nc."}
